split: first floor(0.75*1461) local days train; remaining days test
fit: on finite training pairs, fit daily log1p PM2.5 = month-of-year intercept + phi times prior-day residual by deterministic least squares
prediction_metric: test RMSE on dates whose observed and required lag values are finite
separation_control: construct full-length one-step residuals using training-only coefficients, robust-scale by training residual MAD, and recompute the frozen primary SEP surface with the same registered null permutations
baseline_explains_primary: true when primary T_e is observed but the residual SEP at primary T_e is false or no residual contiguous survival begins there
tld_derived_gate: if the primary study is positive, SEP must persist at primary T_e after this baseline control
